# Ravel: Knitting Patterns

> Ravel is a free knitting row counter for iPhone and iPad. Read your own PDF patterns, track your yarn stash, and get patterns written to your size and gauge.

## App

- [Ravel: Knitting Patterns - Row Counter & Patterns for iPhone and iPad](https://jackwallner.com/ios/ravel/index.html.md): Ravel is a free knitting row counter for iPhone and iPad. Read your own PDF patterns, track your yarn stash, and get patterns written to your size and gauge.
